ill-drive.alt: An electric bike from the side: a battery bolted to the down tube and a motor around the bottom bracket; inset, a fat rear hub with a cable coming out.

callouts.3: Or a motor in the rear hub, with its cable

ill-discipline.alt: Five bike silhouettes — road, gravel, mountain, city and kids — each with the detail that sets it apart.

callouts.1: Road: bars curling down, narrow tyres
callouts.2: Gravel: the same bars, wide knobbly tyres
callouts.3: Mountain bike: telescopic fork
callouts.5: Kids: small wheels, 24 inch or less

ill-discipline-road.alt: Silhouette of a road bike with curved bars and narrow tyres.

ill-discipline-gravel.alt: Silhouette of a gravel bike with curved bars and wide tyres.

ill-discipline-mtb.alt: Silhouette of a mountain bike with a telescopic fork and knobbly tyres.

ill-discipline-city-hybrid.alt: Silhouette of a city bike with a low frame, mudguards and a rack.

ill-discipline-kids.alt: Silhouette of a small kids' bike with a training wheel.

ill-wheel-size.alt: Close-up of a tyre sidewall carrying the ETRTO marking 40-622, with 622 circled.

callouts.3: 622: rim diameter in millimetres, the number that matters

ill-wheel-size-700c.alt: A 700C wheel with a narrow tyre, 622 mm rim diameter.

ill-wheel-size-650b.alt: A 650B wheel with a wide tyre, 584 mm rim diameter.

ill-wheel-size-29.alt: A 29 inch mountain-bike wheel with a knobbly tyre, 622 mm rim diameter.

ill-wheel-size-27-5.alt: A 27.5 inch mountain-bike wheel with a knobbly tyre, 584 mm rim diameter.

ill-wheel-size-26.alt: A 26 inch wheel, 559 mm rim diameter.

ill-wheel-size-24.alt: A 24 inch wheel, 507 mm rim diameter.

ill-wheel-size-20.alt: A 20 inch wheel, 406 mm rim diameter.

ill-wheel-size-16.alt: A 16 inch wheel, 305 mm rim diameter.

ill-brake-type.alt: Five brakes compared: rim caliper, V-brake and cantilever seen head-on, then two disc brakes, one pulled by a cable, one fed by a hose.

callouts.1: Caliper: a single arch over the tyre
callouts.2: V-brake: two upright arms joined by a crossing cable
callouts.3: Cantilever: short arms and a triangular straddle wire
callouts.4: Mechanical disc: a cable housing reaches the caliper
callouts.5: Hydraulic disc: a hose screwed into the caliper

ill-brake-type-rim-caliper.alt: A caliper brake arching over the tyre.

ill-brake-type-v-brake.alt: A V-brake: two upright arms joined by a crossing cable.

ill-brake-type-cantilever.alt: A cantilever brake: two short arms and a triangular straddle wire.

ill-brake-type-disc-mechanical.alt: A disc brake caliper pulled by a cable in its housing.

ill-brake-type-disc-hydraulic.alt: A disc brake caliper fed by a hose screwed onto a fitting.

ill-brake-mount.alt: Three caliper mounts seen from the side — flat mount, post mount and IS — with the direction of the bolts.

callouts.1: Flat mount: bolts entering from below
callouts.2: Post mount: two vertical bolts from above
callouts.3: IS: horizontal bolts through two tabs, with an adapter

ill-cockpit.alt: Four handlebars: drop, flat and riser seen head-on, swept-back seen from above.

callouts.2: Straight from end to end: flat bar
callouts.3: Rises on either side of the stem: riser bar
callouts.4: Sweeps back towards you (seen from above): swept-back bar

ill-cockpit-drop.alt: A drop bar seen head-on, its ends curling downwards.

ill-cockpit-flat.alt: A flat bar seen head-on, straight from end to end.

ill-cockpit-riser.alt: A riser bar seen head-on, rising on either side of the stem.

ill-cockpit-swept.alt: A swept-back bar seen from above, curving strongly towards the rider.

ill-drivetrain.alt: Cranksets with one, two and three chainrings, an internal gear hub and a singlespeed drivetrain.

callouts.2: Two chainrings and a front derailleur
callouts.3: Three chainrings
callouts.4: Large, smooth hub with a single sprocket: internal gears
callouts.5: One chainring, one sprocket, no shifter: singlespeed

ill-drivetrain-derailleur-1x.alt: A crankset with a single chainring.

ill-drivetrain-derailleur-2x.alt: A two-chainring crankset with its front derailleur.

ill-drivetrain-derailleur-3x.alt: A three-chainring crankset with its front derailleur.

ill-drivetrain-igh.alt: A large, smooth internal gear hub with a single sprocket.

ill-drivetrain-singlespeed.alt: A singlespeed drivetrain: one chainring, one sprocket and no derailleur.

ill-transmission.alt: A chain above a toothed belt, and the rear stay that opens to let the belt through.

callouts.2: Belt: a flexible band with even teeth
callouts.3: Frame splitter bolt on the right chainstay

ill-speeds.alt: A cassette seen from behind with its eleven sprockets numbered, and a shifter whose window shows the number of speeds.

callouts.1: Count the sprockets on the cassette
callouts.2: Or read the number on the shifter or the hub

ill-shifter.alt: Six shifters compared: integrated in the brake lever, triggers, twist grip, thumb lever, bar-end lever and electronic buttons.

callouts.1: The brake lever swings sideways: integrated shifters
callouts.3: A collar turns around the grip
callouts.4: A lever on top of the bar, pushed with the thumb
callouts.5: A lever at the end of the bar
callouts.6: Buttons and a battery, no gear cable: electronic

ill-shifter-sti-integrated.alt: A road brake lever that swings sideways to change gear.

ill-shifter-trigger.alt: A trigger shifter under the bar.

ill-shifter-grip.alt: A ridged collar that twists around the bar, next to the grip.

ill-shifter-thumb.alt: A thumb shifter: a lever on top of the bar.

ill-shifter-bar-end.alt: A shifter at the end of a drop bar.

ill-shifter-electronic.alt: An electronic shifter: buttons on the lever and a battery, no gear cable.

ill-pedals.alt: Five pedals: flat with pins, SPD with its two-bolt cleat, road clipless with its large triangular cleat, toe clips with cage and strap, and a combination pedal.

callouts.1: Pins on a wide platform: flat
callouts.2: Small recessed mechanism, two-bolt cleat: SPD
callouts.3: Large triangular cleat: road clipless
callouts.5: One flat face, one clipless face: combination

ill-pedals-spd.alt: A mountain clipless pedal with its two-bolt cleat.

ill-pedals-road-clipless.alt: A road clipless pedal with its large triangular cleat.

ill-pedals-toe-clips.alt: A toe clip pedal from the side: the cage and strap above the pedal.

ill-pedals-combo.alt: A combination pedal: one flat face, one clipless face.

ill-suspension.alt: A full-suspension mountain bike from the side: a telescopic fork at the front and a shock between the seat tube and the rear triangle.

callouts.1: Telescopic fork: two tubes sliding into one another
callouts.2: Rear shock, between the seat tube and the rear triangle

ill-seatpost.alt: A dropper seatpost close up: its sliding part, the cable running into the frame, the lever on the bar and the seat clamp.

callouts.1: Lever on the bar, usually on the left
callouts.2: Cable running into the post or the frame
callouts.3: Sliding part of the dropper post
callouts.4: Seat clamp: all a rigid post has

ill-tire-system.alt: A tubeless set-up: the tyre in cross-section on its rim with sealant inside, and a valve with its removable core pulled out.

callouts.3: The word “tubeless” on the tyre sidewall or the rim

ill-e-motor.alt: On the left a mid-drive motor: an angular housing around the crank axle; on the right a very large rear hub with a cable coming out.

callouts.1: Wide, angular housing around the crank axle: mid-drive motor
callouts.2: Rear hub much larger than normal: hub motor
callouts.3: Cable coming out of the hub

ill-e-battery.alt: Three electric bikes: a battery integrated in the down tube with its lock, a battery bolted onto the tube, and a battery on the rear rack.

callouts.1: Integrated: inside the down tube, with a lock
callouts.2: External: a block bolted onto the down tube
callouts.3: On the rear rack, above the wheel

pad-wear-disc.alt: Disc brake pad seen from the side: the metal backing plate, the friction lining and the 1 mm wear limit.

callouts.3: Wear limit: 1 mm

pad-wear-rim.alt: Rim brake block: the wear grooves and the rim braking surface.

rotor-true-check.alt: Rotor inside the caliper seen from above: the gap between rotor and pads, the rotor, and the engraved minimum thickness.

callouts.3: Engraved minimum thickness

chain-wear-checker.alt: Chain checker resting on a chain: the 0.5 % side, the 0.75 % side and a chain roller.

callouts.3: Chain roller

derailleur-limit-screws-h-l-b.alt: Rear derailleur seen from behind: the H and L limit screws and the B-tension screw.

callouts.3: B screw (jockey-to-sprocket gap)

barrel-adjuster.alt: Barrel adjuster where the housing meets the derailleur.

saddle-height-heel-method.alt: Rider seated with the heel on the pedal at the bottom of the stroke, leg straight.

callouts.3: Crank in line with the seat tube

cleat-ball-of-foot.alt: Shoe on the pedal: the ball of the foot directly above the pedal axle.

sag-measure-oring.alt: Fork stanchion with its O-ring pushed down and the travel markings.

axle-qr-vs-thru.alt: Lever quick release next to a screwed thru-axle.

ebike-battery-connector.alt: E-bike battery connector: the contacts and the key lock.
